tldr: Sun through the 10th house brings focus to career, reputation, authority, and public contribution.
body: Sun transiting the 10th house illuminates career, reputation, authority, and public contribution. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports visibility, leadership, and professional direction: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or measuring worth only by public success.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 10th house deliberately. Work with career, reputation, authority, and public contribution without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
